chapter: National Guard band and first jobs in Chicago
title: Columbia Tavern at 31st and State, and Louis Armstrong stopping by
summary: He joined Bernie Young's band at the Columbia Tavern; Louis Armstrong dropped in to hear the five-piece group.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yeah, he's got 1922 -- joined Bernie Young's band in Columbia Tavern, Chicago.
Yeah, that's right, 31st and State Street.

Yeah. (Unintelligible) used to come by out there and stop. He was crazy about that little five piece group we had, and on his way over (unintelligible) moved to the -- Uncle Joe Oliver whatchacallit, (unintelligible) a job, he'd always stop in to hear these there when we used five pieces and say, okay, Pops. We never called him Pops them. We called him Louie. I was there when Louie first get off the boat, you know, when he came from -- Cuesth and Fate left Charlie (unintelligible) in Big Marable, and he came down, and Louie always was a very fine fellow.
